finding: TasksService.update assigned a fresh completedAt every time a caller sent status DONE, so retrying an already completed task changed its historical completion time. The update now preserves before.completedAt for DONE-to-DONE updates, stamps a new Date only when entering DONE, clears it when reopening, and leaves it untouched when status is omitted.
tests: 3 tests passed against the actual TasksService.update implementation with explicit Prisma and audit doubles.
limitations: No live Prisma/database or Nest application boot was used.
The project-local loader removes standalone Nest decorator syntax solely to let Node parse the actual service body.
Concurrent updates and transaction boundaries are not covered.

sourceMap.service: apps/api/src/modules/tasks/tasks.service.ts reads before, builds status/completedAt data, updates Prisma, then audits
sourceMap.state: Task.status uses OPEN/IN_PROGRESS/BLOCKED/DONE/CANCELLED and completedAt is nullable in packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma
sourceMap.failureBoundary: findUniqueOrThrow remains the missing-task boundary; audit logging remains after the update
